source_caption:
When casting started, the role of Lisbeth Salander was originally offered to Natalie Portman, but she declined due to exhaustion. Scarlett Johansson was also considered, and although her audition went great, director David Fincher considered her too sexy, and feared that all media attention would focus on her nude scenes (which indeed happened two years later with Johansson's Under the Skin (2013)). Jennifer Lawrence was considered too, but she was rejected for being too tall. Finally, Rooney Mara was cast.
-

source_details.synopsis: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo is a 2011 thriller film directed by David Fincher from a screenplay by Steven Zaillian. It is based on the 2005 novel of the same name by Stieg Larsson. Starring Daniel Craig as journalist Mikael Blomkvist and Rooney Mara as Lisbeth Salander, it tells the story of Blomkvist's investigation to find out what happened to a girl from a wealthy family who had disappeared 40 years earlier. He recruits the help of Salander, a computer hacker. Sony Pictures began development on the film in 2009.
